name_en: Goma gohan — glutinous rice steamed with roasted black sesame
summary_ja: よく炒ってすった黒ごまをもち米に混ぜて蒸し上げる、津軽地方の「色飯」のひとつ。真っ黒な見た目から仏事に供えられる一方、砂糖を加えて甘くし田植えや祭りに作る地域もある。
summary_en: Roasted, ground black sesame is mixed into steamed glutinous rice — one of Tsugaru's "colored rice" dishes, its dark color offered at Buddhist rites, or sweetened with sugar for rice-planting and festival days.
